definitions:
V7 checks: SAM / MedSAM variants of phase 2, and four run checks.
Writes results/v7/sam_checks_v7.json and results/v7/SAM_CHECKS_V7.md.
Run from the rebuild folder:  python scripts/v7/sam_checks_v7.py

Data and definitions
- Datasets: the 11 REFS and the control azh_train_slice (perimage_v6), with the
  perimage_v6 exclusions (8 FUSeg and 47 control images) unless a section says
  "all images". Kaggle score files hold every image in perimage32 order; the
  order is checked by comparing gt_fraction with perimage32 image by image.
- Metrics: Dice and NSD at tau = 2 px ("nsd"), per image, as stored. In the
  rescore files the same quantities are var[image][model][P0][dice] and
  var[image][model][P0][nsd2], rounded to 5 decimals by k2_rescore._r.
- Method columns:
    sam_vitb_box, medsam_vitb_box   run 1, reference (oracle) boxes, Hugging
                                    Face SamProcessor preprocessing (V6 group S)
    medsam_fixed_gtbox              phase 2, MedSAM with the official
                                    MedSAM_Inference.py preprocessing, oracle boxes
    sam_nnbox, medsam_fixed_nnbox   phase 2, boxes from nnU-Net's mask (no
                                    reference information)
    nnunet_2d                       run-1 nnU-Net scores (the column in M11/M19)
    nnunet_rescore_P0               phase-2 re-prediction of the same nnU-Net
                                    checkpoint, P0 pipeline; its masks are the
                                    ones the nnbox prompts were drawn from
  M19 and the other groups come from perimage_v7.load7 (architecture score =
  mean over available seeds).
- Bootstrap (same design as scripts/v6/practical_v6.py, boot_weights COPIED
  from there because importing practical_v6 runs the whole analysis):
  resample resampling units (photograph for Medetec and AZH incl. control,
  image otherwise) with replacement, B = 2000, each image enters with its
  unit's draw count as weight. One weight matrix per dataset, generator
  numpy default_rng([20261010, k]) with k = index of the dataset in
  REFS + [control]; the same draws serve every contrast and both metrics of
  that dataset (paired). Interval = 2.5 and 97.5 percentiles of the
  bootstrap mean differences.
- Agreement (COPIED from scripts/v6/stats_v6.py zr/corrmat/summ, because
  importing stats_v6 runs the full V6 analysis): Spearman correlation
  (Pearson on average ranks) of per-method dataset means between two
  datasets over a method set. wound pairs = mean over the 6 wound-wound pairs
  of the 11 REFS; modality_diff = mean of the 16 same-modality pairs minus
  mean of the 39 across-modality pairs; modality_diff_excl_within_source =
  13 different-source same-modality pairs minus the 39 across-modality pairs.
  The copy is checked against results/v6/stats_v6.json (group M point values).

part1b.rule: k2_sam.predict_nn: boxes = kit_run.gt_boxes(nnU-Net P0 mask) (up to 10 largest 8-connected components); no component -> no box -> medsam_prob/sam_proc_prob return an all-zero probability map -> empty prediction, scored with the study's convention (Dice and NSD 1 if the reference is also empty, else 0). nnU-Net masks are not in the local results, so empty masks are inferred: exact for empty references (Dice 1 iff prediction empty); for non-empty references an image with Dice 0 and NSD 0 at every tolerance (1, 2, 3, 5 px, 1% diagonal) is either empty or a miss farther than every tolerance (upper bound); flagged images where an nnbox variant scores above 0 are provably non-empty and removed from the upper bound.

failure: manet_r18_in_s2: non-finite weights after training (36 tensors, e.g. ['decoder.blocks.0.hl_conv.0.1.running_mean', 'decoder.blocks.0.hl_conv.0.1.running_var', 'decoder.blocks.0.hl_conv.1.1.running_mean']); not saved
manet_r50_s0: non-finite weights after training (397 tensors, e.g. ['encoder.conv1.weight', 'encoder.bn1.weight', 'encoder.bn1.bias']); not saved
manet_r50_s2: non-finite weights after training (397 tensors, e.g. ['encoder.conv1.weight', 'encoder.bn1.weight', 'encoder.bn1.bias']); not saved

recipe.optimizer: AdamW lr 3e-4, weight_decay 1e-4; CosineAnnealingLR(T_max = 40 epochs) stepped per epoch
recipe.amp: torch.autocast(cuda) (fp16) for the forward pass, loss on .float() logits, torch.amp.GradScaler

part2c.note: rescore values are rounded to 5 decimals, so 5e-6 is the rounding floor

part2d.name: nnunet_2d
part2d.why_no_grid: nnunet_heldout.json stores only the per-image P0 Dice at 0.5; k2_rescore.rescore_nnunet deletes the probability maps (rescore_pred_out) after a successful run, so the sweep rule cannot be applied afterwards

summary: DICE, official MedSAM preprocessing (oracle boxes) minus run-1 MedSAM: higher in 6 of 12 sets (medetec, co2wounds, azh, kvasir_disjoint, kvasir_sessile, azh_train_slice), lower in 3 (etis_larib, ph2, tn3k_test), differences -0.253 to +0.352. MedSAM fixed stays below run-1 SAM oracle in 12 of 12 sets.

NSD, official MedSAM preprocessing (oracle boxes) minus run-1 MedSAM: higher in 6 of 12 sets (medetec, co2wounds, azh, kvasir_disjoint, kvasir_sessile, azh_train_slice), lower in 3 (fuseg, etis_larib, ph2), differences -0.148 to +0.153. MedSAM fixed stays below run-1 SAM oracle in 12 of 12 sets.
DICE, sam_nnbox minus nnU-Net on the 4 wound sets + control: range -0.015 to +0.009; interval above 0 in none, below 0 in none.
NSD, sam_nnbox minus nnU-Net on the 4 wound sets + control: range -0.046 to +0.117; interval above 0 in ['azh', 'azh_train_slice'], below 0 in ['medetec'].
DICE, medsam_fixed_nnbox minus nnU-Net on the 4 wound sets + control: range -0.175 to -0.043; interval above 0 in none, below 0 in ['medetec', 'co2wounds', 'fuseg', 'azh'].
NSD, medsam_fixed_nnbox minus nnU-Net on the 4 wound sets + control: range -0.358 to +0.010; interval above 0 in none, below 0 in ['medetec', 'co2wounds', 'fuseg', 'azh'].
No nnU-Net box (prediction empty, so nnbox = nnU-Net exactly): at most 35 of 564 wound images and at most 581 of 690 colonoscopy images (analysis sets); exactly confirmed only 1 (empty references).
DICE agreement, M19 (19) vs M19 + both nnbox (21): wound pairs 0.211 -> 0.332, modality_diff 0.225 -> 0.316 (+sam_nnbox only: 0.237, 0.278; +medsam_fixed_nnbox only: 0.314, 0.273).
NSD agreement, M19 (19) vs M19 + both nnbox (21): wound pairs 0.473 -> 0.524, modality_diff 0.359 -> 0.428 (+sam_nnbox only: 0.449, 0.377; +medsam_fixed_nnbox only: 0.548, 0.420).

Dice rank among M19 plus the variant (of 20) on medetec, co2wounds, fuseg, azh: sam_nnbox [3, 5, 11, 2], medsam_fixed_nnbox [19, 20, 20, 19]. A method that is last on every wound set adds concordant ranks to every wound pair, so the rise in wound-pair agreement from medsam_fixed_nnbox is mechanical, not evidence that the wound datasets agree more.

nnU-Net rescore vs run 1: 172 of 1712 images differ in Dice beyond rounding (max 0.003382), 46 in NSD (max 0.005401); largest dataset-mean change 2.6e-05 Dice, 8.3e-05 NSD; no mean changes at the third decimal; no rank change; same pipeline in both runs, so GPU floating-point non-determinism, not a bug; no reported number uses the rescore nnU-Net values except the rescore sensitivity family and the nnbox prompts.

Diverged trainings: only MAnet (manet_r18 seed 2, manet_r50 seeds 0 and 2); first non-finite losses in epochs 11 to 20, 11 to 20, 1 to 10; recipe identical to run 1 apart from the seed (AdamW 3e-4, wd 1e-4, cosine over 40 epochs, fp16 AMP with GradScaler, batch 16). No saved model has a threshold at the grid edge or a non-finite step; sweep Dice below 0.76 only for pspnet_r18_in (run 1), pspnet_r18_in_s1, pspnet_r18_in_s2.
Consistency: pretrained_s0, kvasir_nets and kvasir_unet reproduce run 1 to the 5e-6 rounding floor (recomputed independently); only nnU-Net differs (see above).

nnU-Net held-out FUSeg (n = 148): mean Dice 0.8328 at 0.5; the sweep threshold cannot be recovered (probability maps not kept). On the test sets themselves the best grid threshold would add at most +0.031 Dice (descriptive, optimistic).
